Software Engineer II
San Mateo, CA
Role Overview
Sony Interactive Entertainment LLC seeks a Software Engineer II in San Mateo, CA to own build integration, dependency management, type registration, and repository level platform infrastructure.
Requirements
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science or related field or equivalent and two (2) years of experience developing application features, platform integrations, and device interfacing using C++; performing performance analysis and optimization using profiling, monitoring, and diagnostic tools including performance profilers, local logging systems, and runtime monitors; developing automated testing frameworks, regression suites, and unit tests using Jest/NUnit to improve software quality and reliability; debugging and resolving system level issues through root cause analysis and systematic troubleshooting; developing software that interfaces with runtime environments, software development kits (SDKs), and device hardware; developing APIs and data processing systems for software integration, data exchange, and application services using relational databases, cloud services, and platform Web APIs; developing, modifying, and optimizing software architecture components using object-oriented programming (OOP) principles and architectural design patterns including MVP and MVC; developing user interface components for desktop, console, and platform applications. Telecommuting and/or working from home may be permissible pursuant to company policies.
